id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying bluesky syncs a privacy setting always blocks

review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies warehouse ingestion metadata and user-facing error handling for Bluesky account privacy settings, distinguishing account privacy blocks from missing account errors.
review.reason: Adds a specific error message for Bluesky 403 responses and updates warehouse source metadata to classify Bluesky failures, improving user guidance and backend consistency.
review.uncertainty: The actual impact depends on whether this distinction significantly improves user experience or backend reliability, which cannot be verified without testing or release notes.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new error message for Bluesky 403 responses, distinguishing account privacy settings from missing handles.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides clearer user guidance when Bluesky account privacy settings block logged-out access, rather than treating it as a missing account.

observations.behavior: Adds Bluesky to the list of warehouse sources returning 403 status codes, alongside existing 403 sources.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates warehouse ingestion metadata to classify Bluesky failures as 403, aligning with the backend implementation.
